# Food scanning third-party assets

These files are unmodified, pinned browser distributions fetched from the official
npm registry. asset-manifest.json records package versions, source tarballs,
verified npm SHA-512 integrity values, and the SHA-256 of each runtime asset.
The consolidated_notice_sources entries locate the original, unchanged license
texts within this document and retain their original source metadata.
No npm install scripts were run.

## Barcode decoding

- **@zxing/browser 0.2.1**: zxing-browser.min.js, the standalone UMD browser build.
  MIT license: [ZXING_BROWSER_LICENSE.txt](#zxing_browser_licensetxt).
  Upstream: https://github.com/zxing-js/browser
- The bundle includes ZXing library code under Apache-2.0:
  [ZXING_LIBRARY_LICENSE.txt](#zxing_library_licensetxt).
  Copyright and license comments from the upstream unminified bundle are retained in
  [ZXING_BUNDLED_NOTICES.txt](#zxing_bundled_noticestxt).
  Upstream: https://github.com/zxing-js/library

## Nutrition-label OCR

- **tesseract.js 7.0.0**: tesseract.min.js and worker.min.js.
  Apache-2.0: [TESSERACT_JS_LICENSE.txt](#tesseract_js_licensetxt).
  The adjacent .LICENSE.txt files retain notices supplied with the upstream
  browser bundles, including MIT/BSD components.
  Upstream: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- **tesseract.js-core 7.0.0**: the three LSTM-only .wasm.js variants in core/.
  Apache-2.0: [TESSERACT_CORE_LICENSE.txt](#tesseract_core_licensetxt).
  These upstream JavaScript files embed their complete WebAssembly binaries.
  Separate .wasm files are therefore unnecessary.
  Upstream: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- **@tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0**: 4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz, copied to
  lang/eng.traineddata.gz. This compact, integer English LSTM model is about
  3 MB compressed. The npm package metadata declares MIT; the upstream trained
  data repository distributes its data under Apache-2.0:
  [TESSDATA_LICENSE.txt](#tessdata_licensetxt).
  Upstream: https://github.com/naptha/tessdata

Only English recognition data and LSTM cores are included. Initialize OCR with
createWorker('eng', 1, {workerPath, corePath, langPath, workerBlobURL: false,
legacyCore: false, legacyLang: false}), where corePath points at this folder's
core/ directory and langPath at lang/. Version 7 automatically selects the
plain, SIMD, or relaxed-SIMD LSTM core supported by the browser.

These files are served by the app itself. Recognition does not require a public
CDN, and photo data is processed by the browser.

## Bundled JavaScript dependency licenses

The Tesseract browser bundle source maps identify base64-js, bmp-js, buffer,
idb-keyval, ieee754, is-url, regenerator-runtime, wasm-feature-detect, and zlibjs.
Their full upstream license texts are retained below in this file. The manifest records
the pinned packages used as notice sources; these are license copies only,
not additional runtime dependencies or a claim about hidden bundle versions.
